paper.title_en: An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone
paper.abstract_en: We propose a background independent quantization of vacuum general relativity on four dimensional Lorentzian spacetimes. Starting from first order gravity, we solve the gravitational constraints on intersecting null cones of a bulk subregion and obtain the reduced phase space at finite $G_N$. We promote its canonical Poisson brackets to commutation relations and use deformations of the reduced action to define an algebra of observables. Equipped with this, we use Gaussian wavefunctions of canonical pairs to construct a nonperturbative Hilbert space representation, for which this algebra generates a type I factor. By composing amplitudes between states prepared on null cones, we then obtain a Lorentzian path integral in which each sum over intermediate states converges absolutely. As a check, we compute the amplitude for graviton pair creation and annihilation on a null cone nonperturbatively in $G_N$ and find a finite closed form expression, even though expanding first in $G_N$ yields a logarithmic divergence. We next use diffeomorphism invariance of the path integral to show that a macroscopic causal diamond with a given maximum size has a finite dimensional Hilbert space. From the Lorentzian trace we obtain the Bekenstein Hawking entropy for marginally trapped surfaces and calculate its logarithmic correction for large Schwarzschild black holes, recovering at one loop the coefficient Sen obtained through Euclidean methods. We end by deriving the semiclassical Einstein equations to one loop as the low energy limit of this theory.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文从零锥出发对真空广义相对论进行背景无关的代数量子化，涉及约束求解、约化相空间、可观测量代数、I型因子、洛伦兹路径积分、引力子对产生振幅、因果钻石有限维希尔伯特空间、Bekenstein-Hawking熵与对数修正、以及单圈半经典爱因斯坦方程，属于广义相对论基础与量子引力方向的深度理论研究；虽然主题偏量子引力而非所支持的三个修改引力方向，但理论深度与方法完整度较高，值得点击阅读全文。
decision.title_zh: 从零锥出发的引力代数量子化
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种在四维洛伦兹时空上对真空广义相对论的背景无关量子化。从一阶引力出发，我们在一个体子区域的相交零锥上求解引力约束，并在有限 $G_N$ 下得到约化相空间。我们将其正则泊松括号提升为对易关系，并利用约化作用量的形变来定义可观测量代数。在此装备下，我们使用正则对的Gaussian波函数构造非微扰希尔伯特空间表示，该代数在此表示中生成一个 I 型因子。通过在零锥上制备的态之间组合振幅，我们随后得到一个洛伦兹路径积分，其中对中间态的每个求和绝对收敛。作为检验，我们在 $G_N$ 中非微扰地计算零锥上引力子对产生与湮灭的振幅，并得到一个有限的闭式表达式，尽管先在 $G_N$ 中展开会给出对数发散。接下来我们利用路径积分的微分同胚不变性证明，一个具有给定最大尺寸的宏观因果钻石具有有限维希尔伯特空间。由洛伦兹迹我们得到边缘俘获面的 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵，并计算其对大 Schwarzschild 黑洞的对数修正，在一圈阶恢复 Sen 通过欧几里得方法得到的系数。最后我们推导出一圈阶的半经典爱因斯坦方程，作为该理论的低能极限。
